Game Overview

Command Touch is a arcade title where travel back to the 70s arcade era with Command Touch. Tap to blast intercontinental missiles and shield your city. As missile speed and numbers surge, your reflexes and strategy face the ultimate test. Can you master the escalating challenge and prevent destruction? Pure retro action awaits!
